design_parameters.enrich_notes: Volume 1 policy only; WQ BMPs encouraged not required. WQ dry/wet detention cites bleed-down of first 0.5–1.0 in runoff with residence 12–24 h (dry) and 24–60 h (wet)—ranges not mapped to single canonical fields. Detention quantity drawdown is 72 h (Section 6.6.4). Permanent pool max 12 ft (144 in). Length:width at least 4:1 for WQ dry/wet detention. BMP design detail deferred to Volumes 2–3.
